rejection.application_already_has_employment: This application already has an employment. A second one cannot be attached.
rejection.application_already_hired: This candidate has already been hired for this vacancy.
rejection.application_closed: This application has concluded and can no longer be changed.
rejection.application_not_ready_to_hire: This application has no accepted offer, so nobody can be hired against it.
rejection.application_transition_not_permitted: An application cannot move from {from} to {to}.
rejection.candidate_already_anonymized: This candidate's personal data has already been removed.
rejection.candidate_already_linked: This candidate is already linked to a different person. A link cannot be moved.
rejection.candidate_anonymized: This candidate's personal data has been removed and can no longer be changed.
rejection.candidate_hired: This candidate has been hired, so their record can no longer be erased here.
rejection.candidate_not_linked_to_person: This candidate has not been linked to a person yet.
rejection.code_malformed: "{field}" is not a valid code. Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
rejection.currency_code_malformed: That is not a currency code. Use the three-letter ISO 4217 form.
rejection.date_malformed: {field} is not a date. Use the form YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.document_reference_malformed: That is not a valid document reference.
rejection.email_malformed: That is not an email address we can use to reach somebody.
rejection.feedback_score_out_of_range: A score runs from one to five.
rejection.headcount_out_of_range: That is not a plausible number of people to hire on one requisition.
rejection.hire_incomplete: This hire did not finish, so the application has not been marked hired.
rejection.hire_not_started: This hire has not been started.
rejection.interview_needs_an_interviewer: An interview needs at least one interviewer.
rejection.interview_not_cancellable: Only a scheduled interview can be cancelled.
rejection.interview_not_concludable: Only a scheduled interview can be concluded.
rejection.interview_not_reschedulable: Only a scheduled interview can be moved.
rejection.interview_panel_too_large: That is more interviewers than one panel carries.
rejection.interview_round_out_of_range: Interview rounds are numbered from one.
rejection.interview_window_ends_before_it_begins: An interview cannot end before it begins.
rejection.metadata_entry_too_long: The metadata entry "{key}" is too long.
rejection.offer_not_awaiting_decision: This offer is not waiting for a decision.
rejection.offer_not_issued: This offer has not been sent to the candidate, so there is nothing to answer.
rejection.offer_transition_not_permitted: An offer cannot move from {from} to {to}.
rejection.person_merged: That person's record has been merged into another. Link the surviving record instead.
rejection.requisition_already_filled: Hiring has already begun against this requisition, so its decision can no longer be reversed.
rejection.requisition_already_routed_by_another_ap: This requisition was already decided by a different approval.
rejection.requisition_has_no_decision_to_reverse: There is no decision on this requisition to reverse.
rejection.requisition_headcount_exhausted: This requisition has already filled every position it authorized.
rejection.requisition_not_awaiting_decision: This requisition is not waiting for a decision.
rejection.requisition_not_open: This requisition is not approved, so nothing can be recruited against it.
rejection.requisition_transition_not_permitted: A requisition cannot move from {from} to {to}.
rejection.telephone_malformed: That is not a telephone number we can use to reach somebody.
rejection.text_requires_both_languages: {field} is needed in both English and Arabic.
rejection.too_many_channels: That is more publication channels than one vacancy carries.
rejection.vacancy_closes_before_it_opens: A vacancy cannot close before it opens.
rejection.vacancy_not_publishable: Only a draft vacancy can be published.

conflict.candidate_email_already_known: Somebody with that email address is already a candidate.
conflict.person_already_a_candidate: That person is already recorded as a candidate.
conflict.application_already_open: This candidate already has a live application for this vacancy.
conflict.vacancy_not_accepting_applications: This vacancy is not published, so it is not accepting applications.
conflict.requisition_not_approved: That requisition has not been approved.
conflict.another_offer_is_live: This candidate already holds an offer for this vacancy. Withdraw it first.
conflict.not_on_the_panel: Only an interviewer on the panel may record feedback.
conflict.interview_not_open_for_feedback: This interview did not take place, so there is nothing to record.
conflict.feedback_already_submitted: This interviewer has already recorded their feedback.
conflict.no_accepted_offer: This candidate has not accepted an offer.
conflict.candidate_matches_several_people: More than one person matches this candidate. Link the right one, then try again.
conflict.person_number_required: This candidate is not yet a person on the register, so a person number is needed.

conflict.hire_employment_step_failed: The employment could not be created. The hire has been left where it stopped.
conflict.import_too_large: That import has more rows than a single request accepts.
conflict.export_too_large: This candidate register is too large for a synchronous export.

label.hiringLead: Headcount authorized, the openings raised against it, and everybody moving through them.
label.title: Title
label.notYetAPerson: Not yet on the person register.
label.requisitionNotFound: No requisition with this identifier was returned.
label.applicationNotFound: No application with this identifier was returned.
label.noDecisions: Nobody has decided this requisition yet.
label.headcountIsAuthorized: Hiring is authorized in advance. What is remaining is what may still be filled against this requisition.
label.pipelineIsCounted: Counted by the server for each vacancy. A stage the server did not report is not shown as a nought.
label.namesOnTheRecord: An application carries no candidate name. The name is on the application record, which resolves it with one read.
label.decisionsAreAppended: A decision is appended and never edited; a reversal is another row.
label.nothingReadable: Nothing on this screen could be read.
label.boundaryWrites: Every movement through the pipeline is an API capability the server decides. This screen reads and offers no control, because a request from this portal carries no authenticated principal.
label.boundaryPerson: A candidate is not a person. No national identifier, date of birth or nationality is held here — People collects those at hire.
label.boundaryContact: A candidate's email address and telephone number are published by Recruitment and are not shown here. This record is for the hiring decision.
label.boundaryCompensation: A proposed offer is stored as it was written and never calculated with, and its figures are not shown here. Compensation owns pay.
label.boundaryFeedback: Each interviewer's recommendation is shown as it was given. Nothing is averaged, totalled or turned into a verdict — whether three fours beat one five is a hiring policy this product does not invent.
label.boundaryInterviewers: An interviewer is shown as the employment Recruitment stores. Resolving a name for every panellist on every round is a lookup per row this screen does not make.
label.boundaryOrganization: A position, an organizational unit and a cost centre are shown as the identifiers Recruitment stores. Organization publishes no reachable read by identifier for any of them, and a name cached here would go stale on the first rename.
label.boundaryApproval: A requisition decided by a routed approval carries that approval's identifier. It is not a link: no approval is routed in this deployment, so there would be nothing to open.
label.boundaryHeadcount: Requested, filled and remaining are three figures Recruitment publishes. None is calculated from the others here.
label.boundaryPortal: There is no candidate portal in this phase. Every action here is taken by a recruiter.
label.boundaryDocuments: A résumé or offer letter is a reference into the document store. Recruitment holds no files.
